sentences.text:
Heard learned counsel appearing for the petitioner and learned Assistant Government Pleader for Revenue and learned Assistant Government Pleader for Panchayat Raj appearing for the respondents and perused the entire material on record.
2. Learned Counsel for the petitioner submits that this writ petition is filed by the petitioner questioning the action of the respondents in attempting to grab the petitioner's land admeasuring to an extent of 1 Acre 75 cents in Survey No.522/E/2 of Rekulampalli Village, Devarakadra Mandal,
Mahaboobnagar District, retained by the Petitioner after acquisition of the petitioner's remaining land admeasuring to an extent of 4 acres in Survey No.522/E of Rekulampalli Village, Devarakadra Mandal, Mahaboobnagar District by the Respondent Nos.3 and 4, under political rivalry.
SK,J 3.

Learned Counsel for the petitioner further submits that while admitting, this Court granted interim orders on 20.03.2017 directing the respondents not to dispossess or interfere with the possession of the petitioner in the subject property.

In spite of lapse of nearly 8 years, the respondents did not choose to file any counter or vacate petition in this matter for denying the averments made in the writ affidavit and requested to direct the respondents not to interfere with the possession of the petitioner, without following due process of law.

4. Learned Assistant Government Pleader for Revenue and learned Assistant Government Pleader for Panchayat Raj submit that the respondents will follow the procedure contemplated under law before interfering with the possession of the petitioner in the subject property and pass appropriate orders.
5.

In view of the submissions made by both sides, the writ petition is disposed of directing the respondents not to SK,J interfere with the possession of the petitioner in the subject property,
without following due process of law.

If the respondents want to acquire the land of the petitioner,
they have to follow the procedure under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
